extName.message: Video Declutter — no Shorts, no recommendations

extDescription.message: Hides Shorts, recommendations, autoplay and clutter on YouTube. Scheduled focus mode. No account, no tracking.

featDesc_shorts.message: Shelves, menu entry, channel tab, Shorts in search and subscriptions

feat_shortsRedirect.message: Open Shorts in the normal player

featDesc_homeFeed.message: A calm empty page instead of the feed

featDesc_homeRedirect.message: The logo and Home open your subscriptions

feat_related.message: Hide "Up next" next to the video

featDesc_related.message: Recommendation column on the watch page; playlists stay

featDesc_endscreen.message: Cards over the video, the end video wall, the fullscreen grid

featDesc_autoplayOff.message: The next video will not start by itself

featDesc_liveChat.message: Chat next to live streams and premieres

featDesc_explore.message: The menu section with music, gaming, trending

feat_ads.message: Hide ad slots in the interface

featDesc_ads.message: Cosmetic only: banners, promoted items in feeds and search. No requests are blocked

presetDesc_minimal.message: No Shorts or clutter; recommendations stay

presetDesc_subscriptions.message: Like Focus, and home opens subscriptions

pausedNote.message: Paused — YouTube is shown as is.

notYoutube.message: Open YouTube — settings apply instantly, no reload needed.

reloadHint.message: Reload the YouTube tab to start the extension there.

staleTitle.message: YouTube may have changed its markup

staleText.message: Not matching for a while: $1. Update the rules or wait for a new extension version.

optionsLead.message: Every item works on its own and applies to open tabs instantly.

presetsNote.message: A preset switches every item except comments and chat, which stay your choice.

scheduleOn.message: Turn on Focus during these hours

scheduleNote.message: During these hours the Focus preset is added on top of your settings. It only hides more. The window may cross midnight.

reminderOn.message: Remind me after a daily total of

reminderNote.message: Only time while a YouTube tab is visible and focused counts. The counter stays on this device and resets at midnight.

reminderToast.message: You have spent $1 min on YouTube today. Time for a break?

rulesNote.message: YouTube changes its markup often. All selectors live in one data file validated against a schema. If a rule finds nothing for a while, the popup shows a warning.

remoteOn.message: Update rules from the author’s site

remoteNote.message: Once a day one JSON file with selectors (data only, never code), signed by the author’s key, is downloaded. No cookies, none of your data. If the signature or format is wrong, the bundled rules stay. Off by default.

healthNote.message: Checks the markup of pages you open, at most once per 10 minutes. Nothing is sent anywhere.

aboutText.message: Free, no account, no ads, no analytics. The extension never blocks network requests or downloads videos — it only hides parts of the page.

notIncluded.message: Not in this version: restoring original titles and audio instead of auto-translation. That needs requests to YouTube servers, and this extension works offline.

homeMessage.message:
Home recommendations are hidden.
Search, subscriptions and playlists work as usual.
